description: July 8 birthday meaning: Cancer decan 2, birthday number 8, Life Path by year, Chinese zodiac note and famous birthdays.
answer: In Western astrology, a July 8 birthday falls in Cancer, in the second decan, with Moon as the sign's ruler and Pluto as the decan's. In numerology the day gives birthday number 8. The Life Path also uses the birth year. Cancer is cardinal and water.

sections.heading: July 8 zodiac sign and personality
paragraphs: Determination is the usual word for July 8th. Cancer's cardinal drive, Pluto's persistence and 8's appetite for achievement line up sixteen degrees into the sign. Interpretive traditions picture a protective strategist who builds security for others with real staying power. The softer task is to show the feelings behind all that effort, not just the results.

On July 8 the Sun usually sits at about 16° Cancer, in the second decan, where Pluto is the sub-ruler alongside Moon. In the middle of Cancer, from 10 to 19 degrees, the sub-ruler is Pluto, the modern ruler of Scorpio. That brings an intensity to the Crab's tenderness. Early-July birthdays are often linked with emotional depth, loyalty that runs very deep, and a sharp instinct for what goes unsaid in a room. These Cancerians tend to protect privately and completely, sometimes keeping their own needs hidden behind the shell. Pluto adds resilience and a capacity for real renewal after loss. Learning to trust selectively, rather than all or nothing, usually helps the intensity become a source of steadiness instead of strain.

sections.heading: July 8 in numerology
paragraphs: A birthday on the 8th gives a birthday number of 8 with nothing to reduce. In numerology the day of birth works as a supporting number, a practical aptitude that colours the Life Path. The 8, drawn as two stacked loops, is traditionally linked with balance between the material and inner worlds, and with authority, organisation and ambition. People born on the 8th are often seen as capable managers of money, time and teams. They may also be hard on themselves when results lag. Generosity with the influence they build is commonly regarded as the 8's best expression.

The Life Path, the main number in a numerology chart, also uses the birth year, so it changes from one July 8 birthday to the next: it is 22 for 1960, 5 for 1970, 6 for 1980 and 7 for 1990, for example. Some birth years on this date reach the master number 22.

sections.heading: Born on July 8: season, famous birthdays and Chinese zodiac
paragraphs: July birthdays land in high summer north of the equator, with long warm evenings, and in midwinter in the southern hemisphere. Cancer holds the first three weeks, with Leo arriving around July 22 or 23. In numerology July is month 7, the number of reflection, analysis and inner life, which tends to give these birthdays a thoughtful, private layer beneath the summer brightness. July 8 is the 189th day of the year (190th in a leap year). By July 23, 15 days later, the Sun has usually moved on into Leo.

For the Chinese zodiac, Lunar New Year has always passed by July 8, so the animal is simply the one for the birth year. Well-known people born on July 8 include John D. Rockefeller (1839), Igor Tamm (1895) and Son Heung-min (1992).

faq.question: What zodiac sign is July 8?
faq.answer: July 8 is Cancer in every year from 1930 to 2030, wherever you were born. It falls in the second decan of Cancer, which tradition links with Pluto.

faq.question: What is the Life Path number for someone born on July 8?
faq.answer: It depends on the birth year. On July 8 the Life Path is 22 in 1960, 5 in 1970, 6 in 1980, 7 in 1990, 8 in 2000, 9 in 2010 and 1 in 2020. The birthday number, from the day alone, is 8 for everyone born on the 8th.

faq.question: What Chinese zodiac sign is someone born on July 8?
faq.answer: Chinese astrology is straightforward for a July 8 birthday: the new year began weeks earlier, so the birth year's own animal applies.

faq.question: Which famous people were born on July 8?
faq.answer: July 8 is also the birthday of John D. Rockefeller (1839), Igor Tamm (1895) and Son Heung-min (1992). The list comes from Wikidata and favours people with the most Wikipedia articles.
